name: Adni
long_description:
Adni is the career community for 200,000+ nurses and allied health workers. Members use our app to chat with career coaches, apply for jobs, store and track credentials, shop for gear, connect with recruiters, and find meetups.

Organizations partner with Adni to reach, engage, and hire healthcare workers through our network, verified database of 2.4 million licensed clinicians, AI sourcing agent, and marketing tools. Customers acquire clinicians at 3x lower cost than legacy job boards and advertising platforms.

Our customers include Massachusetts General Hospital, Penn Medicine, ChristianaCare, Medical Solutions, Medline, Jaanuu, and Proliability.

Founded by two nurses. Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, and the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, and Papa.
one_liner: The career community for healthcare workers

founders.founder_bio: Founder & COO at Adni, Nurse, California 2021 Nurse of the Year, and Johnson & Johnson Innovation Fellow from Fresno, CA. Feel free to reach out at jennifferre@adni.co to connect!
